blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The University of Cebu (UC) Baby Webmasters narrowly escaped the Cebu Eastern College (CEC) Blue Dragons, 47-44, in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 high school basketball tournament on Thursday, October 8, at the Cebu Coliseum. The Baby Webmasters cemented their hold on the top spot in the standings, improving to 7-1 while stretching their winning streak to six games. Their sister team, the University of Cebu-Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue (UCLM) Junior Webmasters, and five-peat champions Sacred Heart School-Ateneo de Cebu (SHS-AdC) Magis Eagles are tied for second at 5-0.
